name: codexbot
description: A modified LeaningLearner/codexbot distribution for QQ completion and final failure notifications.

interface.shortDescription: Send Codex completion and failure alerts to QQ.
interface.longDescription: A modified distribution based directly on LeaningLearner/codexbot. It reports completed turns and terminal failures through the official QQ bot sandbox.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Codex normally; this plugin only sends read-only completion and terminal failure notifications to the paired QQ sandbox user.
